tweet.text:
🎯 STRUCK: HAMAS BRIGADE COMMANDER HIDING IN A HOSPITAL WHO HELD NUMEROUS HOSTAGES CAPTIVE.

The Commander of Hamas’ Khan Yunis Brigade Muhammad Abu Ismail & additional terrorists hiding inside of the Nasser Hospital were struck in a targeted IDF & ISA strike in southern Gaza.

Abu Ismail was responsible for directing terrorist attacks against Israeli civilians & IDF troops and for holding numerous hostages captive throughout the war.

Hamas turned the hospital complex into a headquarters to advance dozens of terrorist attacks and restore the brigade’s terror capabilities. Additionally, dozens of hostages were held captive within the hospital. 
 
Prior to the strike, advance warnings were issued to the civilian population & precision-guided munitions and aerial surveillance assets were employed to minimize the risk of harm to civilians.
